title: Fix leading whitespace in minted code block in template.tex
description: The Python code in the minted environment (template.tex lines 111-117) is indented relative to the document margin. minted preserves this whitespace and displays it as indented code. The code should be flush-left inside the minted environment.

title: Remove spurious empty \section{} that triggers unwanted interlude frame
description: template.tex line 164 has an empty \section{} just before \cernSplashWhite. This triggers the \AtBeginSection hook and produces an unwanted 'We are here!' interlude slide before the closing splash. Remove the empty section or suppress the hook locally before the closing slide.

title: Fix broken \mode<all> split across two lines in beamerthemeCERN.sty
description: Lines 104-105 of beamerthemeCERN.sty have \mode on one line and <all> on the next, which is invalid. Should be \mode<all>{} on a single line, or the trailing mode declaration removed entirely as it is typically unnecessary at the end of a theme file.

title: Replace invalid 'px' units with valid LaTeX units in beamerthemeCERN.sty
description: beamerthemeCERN.sty uses 'px' in ht=20px, \vspace{2px}, and \vspace{10px}. 'px' is not a valid LaTeX dimension unit and may produce silently incorrect spacing. Replace with pt, mm, or ex equivalents.

title: Remove duplicate \usecolortheme{default} in beamerthemeCERN.sty
description: Lines 3-4 of beamerthemeCERN.sty call \usecolortheme{default} twice. The duplicate is redundant and should be removed.

title: Source logo assets in official CERN Blue (#0033A0)
description: The design guidelines specify CERN Blue as #0033A0, but the current logo PNGs (cern-logo-small.png, cern-logo-white-on-blue.png, LogoBadge-01.png) appear to have a different blue baked in. The color definition in beamerthemeCERN.sty currently uses #0053A1 to match the existing assets. New logo files matching the official color need to be sourced from CERN brand resources before the color definition can be updated.

title: Design Guidelines
description:
Minimum space around the logo is equal to 1/4 of the width of the logo.
The logo must be a minimum of 60px for Web uses and 15mm in standard office printer.

CERN Blue hex code is #0033A0.

title: Set a non-empty short title in \title[] for the footline
description: template.tex has \title[]{Title} with an empty short title (the [] argument). The theme footline uses \insertshorttitle, so the short title will be blank. Set a meaningful short title, e.g. \title[Short Title]{Full Presentation Title}.

title: Replace custom \def\mydate/\talkdate mechanism with standard \date{}/\insertdate
description: The template uses a custom \def\mydate and \talkdate command instead of beamer's built-in \date{} and \insertdate. The standard approach integrates automatically with PDF metadata and is more idiomatic. Requires updating both beamerthemeCERN.sty (replace \talkdate with \insertdate) and template.tex.

title: Fix \author field to avoid \url breaking PDF bookmark generation
description: template.tex uses \texorpdfstring{\url{name.surname@cern.ch}}{Author} in \author. \url in author fields can break PDF bookmark generation. Replace with \href{mailto:name.surname@cern.ch}{name.surname@cern.ch} or plain text.

title: Remove redundant \usepackage{xcolor} and \usepackage{graphicx} from template.tex
description: Both xcolor and graphicx are already loaded internally by beamer. The explicit \usepackage calls in template.tex lines 4-5 are redundant and add noise to the preamble.

title: Migrate \frame{} short syntax to \begin{frame}...\end{frame} in template.tex
description: template.tex uses the deprecated \frame{...} short form throughout (lines 17, 30, 59, 65, 75, 123, 134, 141, 150, 158). Modern beamer recommends \begin{frame}...\end{frame}, which supports options like [fragile], [allowframebreaks], etc. The minted code frame already correctly uses the modern syntax.

title: Suppress navigation symbols globally in the CERN theme
description: Navigation symbols are only suppressed locally inside \cernSplashBlue and \cernSplashWhite. If a user forgets to suppress them on the title slide, they appear. Add \setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{} globally in beamerthemeCERN.sty so users don't need to handle this manually.

title: Add missing fg color to block title alerted in beamerthemeCERN.sty
description: \setbeamercolor{block title alerted} only sets bg=gray!30 but no fg, unlike \setbeamercolor{block title} which sets both fg and bg. This inconsistency can cause the alerted block title text to inherit an unintended color. Add fg=bluecern or appropriate color.

title: Add \ProvidesPackage declaration to beamerthemeCERN.sty
description: The theme file is missing a self-identification declaration. Adding \ProvidesPackage{beamerthemeCERN}[2024/01/01 CERN Beamer Theme] at the top allows LaTeX to report version info and detect conflicts.

title: Remove redundant \useinnertheme{default} and \useoutertheme{default}
description: beamerthemeCERN.sty lines 5-6 explicitly set inner and outer themes to 'default', which is already the default. These calls add noise without effect and should be removed.

title: Document minted --shell-escape build requirement and provide listings fallback
description: minted requires both Pygments and pdflatex --shell-escape, which is non-obvious and blocks first-time users. Add a comment in template.tex and/or README explaining the requirement. Consider providing a listings-based alternative block as a zero-dependency fallback.

title: Add \hypersetup for PDF metadata (title, author, subject)
description: The template does not configure PDF metadata. Adding \hypersetup{pdftitle={...}, pdfauthor={...}, pdfsubject={...}, colorlinks=true, linkcolor=bluecern} in the preamble improves PDF output quality and accessibility.

title: Add \usepackage{microtype} to template for improved typography
description: microtype improves text rendering through microtypography (character protrusion, font expansion). Even in presentations it can prevent awkward line breaks in dense text blocks. Add to template.tex preamble.

title: Consider LuaLaTeX/XeLaTeX + fontspec for modern font handling
description: The theme uses the legacy helvet + fontenc + sfdefault stack for font setup. Switching the template to LuaLaTeX or XeLaTeX with fontspec (e.g. \setmainfont{TeX Gyre Heros}) provides better Unicode support, true OpenType features, and cleaner font configuration. Document tradeoffs with minted and other packages.
